title: Indivisible
summary: Words meaning not-to-be-broken are broken by the browser's hyphenation, with a hyphen that exists nowhere in the source.
mechanism: CSS hyphens:auto forces the layout engine's per-language hyphenation dictionary to insert render-only break-hyphens absent from the DOM; lang switch and resize re-break the same words differently.
references: Augusto de Campos and the Noigandres group / Brazilian concrete poetry (1950s)
